messages:
maria: Quick sync — drafting a one-pager + launch checklist for enterprise kickoff. Need security/SLA bullets, a tiny deploy-mode compare (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), a short cautious benchmark line, and a webinar CTA. Can folks add must-haves? :pray:

sam: I can take hero copy + PDF micro-layout. Propose two micro-heroes (security-first, platform-first). Keep benchmark neutral.

leo: Benchmark guidance — three short points only: median token latency on a mid-sized RLHF workload, Dedicated throughput at a high level, and fallback behavior when a pinned model is unavailable. Phrase cautiously.

jamie: Field asks: form must capture company size and compliance (HIPAA/SOC2/FedRAMP). Add "deploy mode" selector. Tag leads with "enterprise-security" and "deploy-mode-interest". If Private chosen, route to AE queue X + SE Y.

anna: Sales wants a clear 15-min "prod-fit" CTA. Webinar phrased as a technical deep-dive + live Q&A, not a pitch.

maria: Draft microcopy — Hero (platform): "Inference that scales — predictable throughput, automated fallbacks, and workload-aware cost controls." Subline: "Reduce unit cost while meeting latency SLOs — tune routing, caching, and quantization per workload." Bullets: SLA-backed Dedicated; Private VPC + KMS/HSM; workload-tuned model & quant recommendations. CTAs: [Request 15-min prod-fit] [Watch Benchmark Deep-Dive].

sam: PDF visual: 3-column row Hosted / Dedicated / Private with single-line benefit calls (time-to-value / predictability / data control). Add a 2-line tech note: serving runtime + smart routing + observability.

leo: Benchmark copy (careful): "Internal tests showed Dedicated pools sustaining hundreds of req/min with low median token latencies on mid-sized LLMs. Hosted autoscaling showed comparable tail latency in single-tenant scenarios. Workload-aware caching reduced token spend in our test sets by ~20%+." Will run legal review.

jamie: Routing rule suggestion: if company_size > 1000 AND compliance in (HIPAA, FedRAMP) => AE-high-priority + SE assigned; otherwise standard nurture. Webhook to SFDC/Hubspot.

ops-bot: deploy-note: branch created `marketing/enterprise-kickstart-1744444444` — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/enterprise-kickstart-preview :rocket:

maria: Final ask — include explicit fallback line on the one-pager: "If a pinned model is unavailable, requests will be served from the nearest compatible variant to preserve availability." Lock copy and ping design. Thanks all. :clap:
